tasks.title: HANGS Construction Services · FY2026 Journal Entry Testing
tasks.description: Test HANGS Construction Services LLC’s journal entries for the year ended June 30, 2026 for management override, from 10 Excel, Word and PDF files: the trial balance and the June 30, 2025 balances, the full general ledger export, the manual journal listing, the system’s users, sources and periods, the journal entry policy, the contract schedule, the fixed asset register, the support for the selected entries and management’s answers. Prove the population is complete, profile it, run the risk filters, vouch the selected entries and every year-end top-side entry. Produce formula-linked workpapers with tickmarks and a draft findings memo. The CPA reviews, decides every open item and concludes; the machine gives no opinion.

propertyEvents.result: 26-01261 debits account 1300 and credits Pier 9 revenue $48,000.00, “Revenue earned in June, Pier 9 CO-07 seismic hold-down work, per the p”. It is dated June 30 but was posted on Saturday, August 8 at 9:41 PM, five days after June was closed: the period was never locked (LOCK-01). It was set to reverse, and did, on July 2, 2026 (27-00006). Nothing supports it: the June 30 schedule’s under billings are $61,250.00, and with the entry account 1300 is $109,250.00. The Controller says the project manager’s estimate is to follow; the Chief Financial Officer did not know of it. Revenue and account 1300 are overstated by $48,000.00 (TOP-01).

Set what was found against materiality
propertyEvents.locator: Entries!A8:N, Lines!A8:H, Control Totals!A8:E and After Year End!A8:I; every FY2026 entry and line, the system’s totals and the reversals after June 30

propertyEvents.result: One known misstatement: $48,000.00 of unsupported revenue (TOP-01), 14.1% of materiality, above the clearly trivial $17,000.00. In amount it is small; in kind it is not: a manual revenue entry by the person who closes the books, after the close, at night, unsupported and set to reverse. With JE-01, LOCK-01, SELF-01 and LIST-01 it is what the CPA weighs for management override. The trial balance every FY2026 area read does not hold it; the ledger does. The machine stops here.
